articles.title: Hyundai Motor India July total sales up 25.4 pc at 75,360 units
articles.summary: Hyundai Motor India Ltd reported its highest-ever monthly sales in July 2026, achieving a 25.4 per cent rise in total sales to 75,360 units. This significant growth underscores Hyundai's dominant position and successful strategies in India.

articles.title: 9,000 kmph: SpaceX junk is about to punch a hole in the Moon. Why scientists are happy
articles.summary: A defunct SpaceX rocket stage will impact the Moon at nearly 9,000 km/h. Planetary scientists globally are preparing to observe this event, aiming to study the resulting crater and ejected material. This accidental collision offers a unique opportunity to understand lunar geology and impact dynamics, providing valuable data for future space missions.
